ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 35% high-intensity white pixels localized on the left lateral lobe and 65% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels dominant in the medial and right lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region occupying the outer 50% of the left lobe; low-intensity dark pigmentation across the entire right lobe and central fluke area; small focal white streaks and mottling on the lower right margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped notch with a pixel depth extending approximately 15% of the total fluke height and an acute angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern; left lobe trailing edge contains a significant semi-circular concave indentation; right lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness terminating in a sharp vertical edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a standard convex outer sweep; right lobe exhibits a near-linear, vertical truncation at the distal margin, lacking a traditional tapered sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of high-contrast, circular white pixel groupings localized on the distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four distinct, near-parallel high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the central-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe distal truncation of the right lobe (apparent amputation); irregular tissue/biota accumulation on the left lobe tip; large semi-circular trailing edge notch on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme bilateral asymmetry characterized by the blunt, vertical termination of the right lobe compared to the standard tapered morphology of the left lobe.
